meta.name: clank-orbstack
meta.description: clank + full OrbStack access for the `orb` and `orbctl` CLIs: read/write to ~/.orbstack (config + daemon sockets in ~/.orbstack/run, incl. docker.sock) and the ~/OrbStack guest-VM mount. This is a superset of clank-docker. WARNING: full OrbStack control is a 1-click jailbreak vector — orb can run arbitrary commands inside Linux machines and mount host paths into them, so opt into this only when the orb/orbctl CLIs are actually needed.
meta.author: polarsquad
